kjv: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

lines.say: Trouble on your mind tonight? Read this before bed.
And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me. Psalm fifty, verse fifteen.
lines.big: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

lines.say: He didn't say figure it out. He said call on me.
lines.big: He didn't say figure it out. He said call on me.

lines.say: Lord, I'm calling on you tonight. Deliver me, and I'll give you the glory. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 32 through 56, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
